keyPoints: Vilayan (solution) me ghulne wali cheez viley (solute) aur ghulane wali cheez vilayak (solvent) kehlati hai; cheeni-paani me cheeni viley hai aur paani vilayak.
Paani ko sarv-vilayak kehte hain kyunki usme sabse zyada cheezen ghulti hain — namak, cheeni, kai gasen aur khanij lavan.
Santript vilayan me us taap par aur viley nahi ghulta; garm paani me thande se zyada cheeni ghulti hai kyunki taap se ghulansheelta badhti hai.
Viley ki matra badhane par vilayan sandra (concentrated) aur ghatane par tanu (dilute) kehlata hai; sharbat ko paani milakar tanu kiya ja sakta hai.
Tel paani me nahi ghulta kyunki ye amishraniya drav hain; doodh jaisa dikhne wala mishran palas (colloid) hai jisme kan tairte rehte hain.
Vilayan samgun mishran hai — uska har boond ek jaisa hota hai, isiliye use dekhkar viley-vilayak alag nahi pehchane ja sakte.
Aam galti: ghulna aur pighalna ek samajhna; cheeni paani me ghulti hai (vilayan banta hai), jabki barf garmi se pighalti hai (avstha badalti hai) — dono alag prakriyaen hain.

title: Viley, Vilayak aur Vilayan
